summary: Re-tested the TMDB proxy fix end-to-end: home populated, proxied posters rendered, search and player flows work.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TMDB proxy, home population, anime/batman search, movie filter, clear, gibberish empty state, mobile overflow, player metadata, cast, and server switching were verified.
rca of the issue: The reported empty/skeleton state is resolved by routing TMDB metadata and images through /api/tmdb. Public API tests and browser checks confirmed the proxy returns valid JSON/images and the UI no longer depends on direct TMDB domains.
